params.name: companyName
params.description: Must be provided with country, to search for an exact company name in a given country.

params.name: country
params.description: Must be provided with companyName, to search for an exact company name in a given country. Valid 2-letter country codes are listed in the 'countries' resource.

params.name: identifierScheme
params.description: Identifier scheme used to identify the company (one of the 'companytypes' resource) Each pair of identifierScheme and identifierValue will be interpreted as OR.

params.name: identifierValue
params.description: Company identifier to search for (according to the given identifierScheme)

params.name: email
params.description: E-mail address of one of the users of the company.

params.name: existingConnectionsOnly
params.description: Limit results to only existing connections or only potential connections. Defaults to returning both existing and potential connections.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to display, and size of each page to skip.

params.name: page
params.description: Number of pages of results to skip

params.name: propertyKey
params.description: Name of a property set on the connection.

params.name: propertyValue
params.description: Value of the specified property name on the connection.

params.name: includeShareableIdentifiers
params.description: Applicable when searching by identifiers. If enabled also include results where matching identifiers are shareable. Disabled by default.

items.docs: Search for existing or potential connections based on criteria. One of the following parameter combinations needs to be provided - country and companyName, identifierScheme and identifierValue, propertyKey and propertyValue, or email. All criteria are matched using exact, case-insensitive match unless exactMatch is set as false.
